title: White Sand Retreat - Vacation Rental in Seagrove Beach,FL | 30a Escapes

normalized_matching_profile.name: White Sand Retreat
normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… "White Sand Retreat," a stunning, brand-new construction property in Seagrove Beach! This spacious 5-bed, 4.5-bath home sleeps up to 20 guests, offering a private, seasonally heated pool & spa, a gas grill, and ample living space. Just a short walk to beach access, it's the perfect getaway for large groups or families. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Brand New Construction – This beautiful, newly built home has all of your vacation needs!Private, Seasonally Heated Pool & Spa – Relax and unwind in the ultimate outdoor oasis.Spacious Layout for 20 Guests – Comfortably sleeps up to 20 guests with ample space for everyone.Multiple Primary Suites – Two Primary Suites, each with their own En-suite bath for extra privacy.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Dining – Perfect for family meals, featuring a large kitchen and dining area.Gas Grill – Perfect for outdoor cooking and enjoying meals with family and friends.Walking Distance to Beach Access – Just a short stroll to the beach access for sun, sand, and sea.Parking for 3 Vehicles – Convenient and ample parking for all your guests.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into the beautiful open-concept living space where you'll find plenty of room for relaxation and entertainment. The inviting living room features a cozy fireplace and stylish decor. With spacious areas for everyone to gather, this is the perfect spot to unwind after a day at the beach. A dedicated office space on the second floor provides a quiet place for work or personal projects.Comfortable seating with a fireplace for cozy eveningsOpen concept living, dining, and kitchen areasBright and airy with natural light streaming through large windowsDedicated office space for remote work or quiet moments*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances, perfect for preparing home-cooked meals. The adjacent dining room provides seating for large groups, making it easy to gather together for a meal.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesLarge dining table with plenty of seatingAdditional breakfast bar seating*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside to your private backyard retreat where you can enjoy the serene pool area with a seasonally heated pool and spa. The large space is perfect for outdoor relaxation and dining, with plenty of room to spread out. A gas grill is available for preparing al fresco meals while taking in the beautiful surroundings. Enjoy easy access to the 1st-floor back porch for a quiet morning coffee, or retreat to the second-floor balcony for breathtaking views and coastal breezes.Private, seasonally heated pool & spaGas grill for outdoor cookingSpacious outdoor area for lounging and dining1st-floor back porch for relaxation and easy access to the pool2nd-floor balcony for scenic views and peaceful moments*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary King Suite – King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bath – Conveniently located on the first floor for guests2nd Floor:Queen Guest Suite – Queen bed, flat-screen TV and guest bathroom accessHall Guest Bathroom – Shared between the Queen Guest Suite and Bunk Room, with dual vanities and walk-in showerBunk Room – 2 Full-over-Queen Bunks, 1 Full-over-Full Bunk, flat-screen TV and access to guest bathroomQueen Guest Suite – Queen bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite – King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tub*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in Seagrove Beach, White Sand Retreat offers easy access to some of 30A's most beautiful spots. Walk to nearby beach access for stunning Gulf views, or explore the charming shops and dining options just a short drive away.Beach Access: Just a short 5-minute walk to sugar-white sands and emerald waters, ideal for sunbathing, swimming, or leisurely strolls along the shore.Nearby Attractions: Explore boutique shops, cafes, and restaurants in Seaside, WaterSound, and Grayton Beach, or enjoy live music and dining at The Big Chill.Outdoor Adventures: Discover miles of scenic 30A biking trails with 7 beach bikes, or try kayaking, paddleboarding, and hiking at nearby Grayton Beach and Deer Lake State Parks.Relaxed Atmosphere: A quiet, family-friendly neighborhood offering both relaxation and proximity to vibrant coastal activities.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Pool can be heated between September 1st and April 30th.There is a camera located on the pergola in front of the garage.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
